name: severity-legend
source: Composed from obs-severity (severity.less dots). The product shows this legend row under the Inventory > Monitors list and on NOC/status views.
summary: A responsive severity LEGEND — the row of coloured dots + labels (Down / Critical / Major / Warning / Clear / Unreachable …) under a table, map or chart. Composes obs-severity for every entry. When the container is too narrow, trailing entries COLLAPSE into a '+N' pill with their dots piled up (avatar-style) and a hover popover reveals them; with room, every entry shows in full.

variants.name: full
variants.what: all entries shown as dot + label (wide container).

variants.name: collapsed
variants.what: narrow container — trailing entries fold into a '+N' pile of overlapping dots; hover reveals them in a popover. Automatic via ResizeObserver.

states.name: hover
states.what: pointer over the pile → popover lists the hidden entries

levels.note: the severity levels in order (CSV string or array).

labels.note: optional { level: 'Custom Label' } overrides (JSON string or object); default = capitalized level name.

min-visible.note: never collapse below this many full entries.

decisionFlow: Showing what the severity colours MEAN under a table / map / chart? -> obs-severity-legend (it collapses responsively).
Showing ONE object's severity (a status dot/chip in a row or header)? -> obs-severity, not the legend.
The legend goes in a table footer? -> put it in obs-table's `footer` slot (it forwards into obs-pagination's centered slot).

full.useWhen: the container is wide enough for every entry (the common case).
full.example: the Monitors list footer on a wide screen.

collapsed.useWhen: the container is narrow — handled automatically; trailing entries fold into +N with hover-reveal.
collapsed.example: the Monitors list footer on a laptop/narrow window.

do: Use it for any severity legend (table footer, map, chart) instead of hand-rolling coloured dots.
Let it collapse — give it a flexible container (it fills width and folds trailing entries into +N when tight).
Override labels via `labels` only when the visible text must differ from the capitalized level name.
dont: Don't hand-roll the dots — every entry must be an obs-severity so the DS severity ring/colour stays consistent.
Don't use it for a single object's status — that's obs-severity.

a11y.summary: Each entry is an obs-severity (dot + label). The collapsed pile carries a `title` listing the hidden entries, and the hover popover repeats them as dot + label. Colour is never the only signal — every entry (visible or revealed) pairs the dot with a text label.
issues: The pile reveal is hover-only (no keyboard focus/Escape yet) — follow-up: make the pile focusable with a popover on focus.

knownIssues: Collapse is measured after webfonts settle (a 250ms re-measure); on very slow font loads the first frame may show all entries before folding.
related: table (the legend goes in its footer slot)
pagination (hosts the legend in its centered slot)
changelog: 2026-09-16 — New <obs-severity-legend>: a responsive severity legend that composes obs-severity dots and collapses trailing entries into a '+N' pile (overlapping dots, avatar-style) with a hover popover when the container is narrow. Replaces hand-rolled legend dots; used in the obs-table footer (Monitors list). ResizeObserver-driven; min 64px clearance is provided by the pagination center zone.
